_comment: The production image of this repository and what it is made of (atrium-project#72 A.3).
Checked on every push by the hub's workflow-lint.reusable.yml (tools/ci/image_closure.py):
every first-party file the entrypoint can execute must be listed here or be a hub-canonical
shared component (docs/templates/shared/MANIFEST.json); a listed file it no longer reaches
fails too. Run it locally with: python ../atrium-project/tools/ci/image_closure.py
The pilot pins `-api` (python -m service.api); `base` is the batch CLI of the same stage
(keywords.py), published, never pinned. The research LLM code (llm_run.py, llm_utils.py,
prompt_template.py, vocab_*.py, corpus_review.py) is built only into the `llm` target and is
unreachable from the entrypoint: the controlled kind (atrium-keyword-extract#1) joins this list
when the service gets it. api_util/teitok_read.py and bbox_scale.py are nlp-enrich's, pinned by
stage: statistical keywords of the record or a text, with method and score: POST /extract_keywords, /extract_keywords_text
